name: smwgraphics-snow-clouds
title: Snow/Clouds
description:
This is a very basic "grainy fluff" tileset for both snowy and cloudy environments, intended to replace the one I made back in 2009. It comes with three palettes.

There are extra outline tiles you can add for a Yoshi's Island style "thick chalk outline" effect, but they're completely optional — the graphics work with or without them.
